decisions.reason: An organic vegan superfood drink mix is far from the firm's chemical and waste-to-energy knowledge base, so the firm has little related knowledge to interpret market feedback or improve the product, and it is likely to be dropped.
Modular extensions build directly on the firm's waste-to-energy plant know-how, so the firm can assimilate early results and refine the offering.
The waste oil to energy plant has its own dedicated page, signalling a core competence where the firm's process chemistry and engineering knowledge lets it learn from deployments and keep improving.

Plastic waste to fuel conversion is related to the firm's waste-to-energy and chemical processing expertise, giving it enough knowledge to develop the product, though it is technically riskier and less prominently featured.
